episode_summary: Chris Wands shares his journey from handling rental transactions to becoming a top luxury real estate agent in Miami. He emphasizes the importance of treating every deal with equal importance, leveraging technology like CRM systems, and building a strong team infrastructure before scaling. His insights provide valuable lessons for aspiring agents and team leaders.
